nodes.label: ADR 0178: A DJ app's playlists stay in its DJ collection; GLUE's own go to its GLUE folder
nodes.rationale: After Engine DJ sync support was added, all Engine DJ playlists appeared under GLUE Playlists and couldn't be deleted without re-syncing. The user requested that DJ app playlists stay in their DJ collection unless imported, and that GLUE's own playlists be mirrored in the DJ app under a GLUE folder.

nodes.label: Three kinds of DJ app playlists
nodes.rationale: DJ app's own playlists stay in Source.tree (DJ collection). Imports under Playlists follow their library one-way. GLUE's own playlists can be mirrored to app's GLUE folder both ways.
